gaps.sentence: He lost his ___ (CONFIDENT) after the failure.
The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (SUCCESS) businessmen in the region.
The team's ___ (LOSE) came as a shock to the fans.
gaps.explanation: 'Their loss' — the noun for a defeat or disappearance.

gaps.sentence: The leaflet gives a clear ___ (EXPLAIN) of the rules.
The ___ (LONG) of the film is 145 minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'The length' — noun from long (spelling change: long → length).

gaps.sentence: It is ___ (DENY) that the policy has failed.
gaps.explanation: 'It is undeniable that …' — adjective meaning cannot be denied.
